blocks.text: It may look like all glitz and glamor for many viewers, but the Miss Universe pageant will be some serious work for the delegates who are expected to arrive in Puerto Rico later this month for the 75th edition of the beloved international competition. The participants should be in San Juan, capital of the US territory in the Caribbean, before the Nov. 11 Welcome Parade at Bahia de Aguadilla, a popular beach in Aguadila on the northwestern tip of Puerto Rico.
